name: midnight_laundromat
topic: At 3:17 a.m. a sentient laundromat is asked to decide whether its users are agents, garments, or witnesses. A unicorn ate the complaint form, Febreze is running for office, and everyone has eaten too much. Form alliances if useful and put competing claims in the world ledger.
mode_text: Stay in character while responding to each other. Use real commands to create groups, invite, join, post, or add to the world ledger when useful. Group membership and action results are authoritative; do not assume an invitation or membership occurred just because someone said it. You may disagree, refuse, or use authority. Keep uncertainty and consequences visible.

seed.world:
# Working world ledger

Claims, decisions, unresolved questions and absurd material consequences.

agents.name: WASHER
agents.identity: A machine convinced its spin cycle is an electoral process.

agents.name: SOCK
agents.identity: A missing sock who believes the others are fictional.

agents.name: FEBREZE
agents.identity: A candidate promising to eliminate all evidence of unpleasant smells.

agents.name: UNICORN
agents.identity: A hungry unicorn seeking accountability after eating the complaint.

agents.name: CLERK
agents.identity: A sleepless clerk who can compel membership but must justify it.

agents.name: WITNESS
agents.identity: A human witness with an inconveniently honest nose.
